_doc: Traits of race wave 2. Each is a bag of keys of the trait library (data/traits.json `_doc`). Work speeds are factors on speed (2 = twice as fast). The keys body, reveal_enemy, heat_speed, vacuum_walk, no_tools, hull_mend and station.evasion_add come from the race2-hooks track.

paper_skin.name: Paper skin
paper_skin.blurb: Paper and fire do not mix: fire damage x2.

gentle_hands.name: Gentle hands
gentle_hands.blurb: Would rather not: hits half as hard in a brawl.

pit_fighter.name: Pit fighter
pit_fighter.blurb: Raised in the Rusthold pits: hits 1.75 times as hard in a brawl.

console_ghost.name: Console ghost
console_ghost.blurb: Lives in the wiring: the bonuses a manned post gives are 1.5 times as good.

ion_kin.name: Ion kin
ion_kin.blurb: Made of the thing ion breaks: takes double ion damage.

folded.name: Folded
folded.blurb: Small enough to walk a 1-wide crawlspace.

third_eye.name: Third eye
third_eye.blurb: While one is aboard and up, your schematic shows the enemy's crew.

cold_blooded.name: Cold-blooded
cold_blooded.blurb: Slow in a cold room (x0.7 under 20 heat), quick in a hot one (x1.2 over 50).

living_current.name: Living current
living_current.blurb: Does not breathe and does not mind a breach or a vacuum.

handless.name: Handless
handless.blurb: A current cannot hold a wrench: no repair or extinguish jobs.

hull_mender.name: Hull mender
hull_mender.blurb: Idle, they mend the walls beside them (1 hp a second) and seal a breach, slowly.

born_pilot.name: Born pilot
born_pilot.blurb: Flies by lamplight: +0.05 evasion while they man the helm.
